name: Smart Nanchong / Nanchong intelligent-computing center projects
developer: Nanchong Municipal Data Bureau / local partners
notes: Municipal data-bureau work/budget notices refer to accelerating Smart Nanchong and computing-center key projects, including 智算中心(南充) and supporting Peng'an intelligent computing center filing/construction. MW not disclosed.

name: Nanchong existing data centers / Northeast Sichuan edge big data center
developer: Nanchong local government / telecom operators
notes: Nanchong government materials say the city has the largest internet data center and big-data cloud-computing center in northeast Sichuan; the 川东北边缘大数据中心 had been completed and included as a national new-type-datacenter typical case. MW not disclosed.

name: Neijiang Big Data Center / Neijiang Unicom Southern Sichuan Information Hub
developer: Neijiang municipal agencies / China Unicom Neijiang
notes: Neijiang economic-information budget materials list 内江大数据中心 and 内江联通川南信息枢纽 among smart-city priority projects; later public confirmation of facility scale/status not found in this pass; MW not disclosed.

name: Panzhihua Specialty Industry Big Data Center
developer: Panzhihua Vanadium-Titanium High-Tech Zone / Panzhihua municipal government
notes: Municipal planning PDF describes a Southwest/Panzhihua characteristic big-data center with IDC rooms, network core data center, cloud-computing operations center and application innovation facilities; Sichuan Online reported planned 136-mu Panzhihua specialty-industry big data center. MW not disclosed.

name: Panzhihua Smart City Operations Center / Big Data Center
developer: Panzhihua municipal government / Inspur and partners
notes: Inspur case study: Panzhihua smart-city operations center launched 2020-10-15 integrating municipal data/video resources; district materials note the Panzhihua big data center and smart-city operations management center are operating. MW not disclosed.

name: Suining Smart Center / e-government cloud and big data center
developer: Suining Digital City Technology Co. / China Electronics System Technology
notes: Suining planning says the city has built its first intelligent computing center with 557 racks, 335P general compute and 543P intelligent compute; earlier government replies identify China Electronics-backed Suining Digital City and a RMB0.9bn Smart Suining cloud platform/big data center. MW not disclosed.

name: China Ya'an Big Data Industrial Park / China Ya Cloud Digital Technology City
developer: Ya'an Economic Development Zone / Ya'an municipal government / park operators
notes: Park opened 2019; data-room infrastructure above 23 ha / 230,000 sqm, rack scale reaching 30,000; tenants include Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance; 5th-anniversary report (2024-06) targets a super 10,000-card intelligent-computing cluster. MW not disclosed.

name: China Ya Cloud AI Computing Industry Project / Ya Cloud Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Ya'an Economic Development Zone / China Construction Third Engineering Bureau / Ya'an state-owned partners
notes: Official releases describe a RMB7.5bn AI compute-industry project with intelligent-computing-center buildings, science/innovation buildings, substations and smart-park systems; procurement item puts the Ya Cloud intelligent computing center at ~109.46 mu, RMB1.022bn for three computing-center buildings. MW not disclosed.

name: Shansi Cloud Intelligent Computing Center (善思云智算中心)
developer: Shansi (善思) project company / Ya'an Economic Development Zone
notes: Signed May 2024 as one of three AI-compute cooperation projects (RMB15bn total) at Ya'an Economic Development Zone; planned total investment RMB7bn, compute scale 10,000P, to create an open super-10,000-card intelligent-computing cluster at China Ya'an Big Data Industrial Park. MW not disclosed.

name: Baidu Intelligent Cloud project (Ya'an)
developer: Baidu Intelligent Cloud / Ya'an Economic Development Zone
notes: One of three AI-compute industry cooperation projects signed May 2024 (RMB15bn total) at Ya'an Economic Development Zone alongside the AI-compute industry project and Shansi Cloud IC center; no capacity disclosed.

name: Shutian Chaoyun Data Center Project
developer: Shutian Chaoyun / Ya'an state-owned digital company
notes: Ya'an SASAC page: project includes ~5,800 big-data standard cabinets and compute-center systems (CPU/GPU resource pools, network, security, storage, virtualization, cloud management and scheduling). MW not disclosed.

name: Shuju Chengbao Yibin Intelligent Computing Center at Yangtze River Upper Reaches Regional Big Data Center
developer: Shuju Chengbao / Yibin local partners
notes: Yibin government: the city's first intelligent computing center lit up at the Yangtze River Upper Reaches Regional Big Data Center on 2025-04-18; broader center planned ~250,000 sqm / RMB3bn (phase 1 ~100,000 sqm, 1,250 cabinets); intelligent-compute project RMB0.8bn over three phases, at least 4,000P total and 1,000P phase 1. MW not disclosed.

name: Zigong Smart City Big Data Center
developer: Zigong municipal smart-city project / China Telecom partners
notes: EAST UPS vendor case study: supplied HVDC power and precision-airflow server-cabinet solutions for the Zigong smart-city big data center construction with China Telecom-related smart-city work. Public rack/MW figures not found.

name: Ziyang Tianfu (Huawei) Cloud Computing Center
developer: Ziyang municipal government / Huawei
notes: Went online 2017-08-18, initially with 71 transitional racks (27 in operation, 21 application systems online); Ziyang High-Tech Zone was building a permanent machine room with 1,000 racks planned for 2019. MW not disclosed.

name: Tianjin Artificial Intelligence Computing Center (天津智算中心)
developer: Tianjin Hebei District government / Tianjin AI computing-center operating consortium
notes: Phase-1 engineering completed Dec 2022 with compute equipment in trial operation; Feb 2025 deployed the full DeepSeek model family (first complete platform in Jing-Jin-Ji to do so); 2025 target to hit 1,000 PFLOPS compute scale and build specialized financial/biomedical intelligent-computing centers.

name: Tencent Tianjin High-Tech Cloud Data Center
developer: Tencent
notes: Tencent's north-China hyperscale data center in Tianjin High-Tech Zone/Bolong Lake Science Park officially enabled 2022; reported RMB10bn total investment, 15,000 racks, 300,000-server capacity; Tencent later announced a 10.54MW distributed solar microgrid at the campus. IT load MW not disclosed.

name: Sinnet Tianjin Baodi Cloud Computing Base Phase I
developer: Beijing Sinnet Technology Co. / Sinnet Tianjin Information Service
notes: Listed-company feasibility report for 天津宝坻云计算基地一期: Baodi Economic Development Zone project would build two standard cloud-computing-center buildings with ~5,000 5kW 2N standard cabinets. Capacity_mw calculated from 5,000 x 5kW cabinet design.

name: China Telecom Jing-Jin-Ji Big Data Base
developer: China Telecom Group
notes: Design-institute case page locates China Telecom's Jing-Jin-Ji Big Data Base in Tianjin Wuqing: 164,415 sqm land, twelve data-center buildings totaling 312,700 sqm, three power centers (31,000 sqm) plus support buildings. MW not disclosed.

name: Tianjin Huayuan Unicom Data Port Data Center
developer: China Unicom Tianjin / IDC operator partners
notes: Commercial listing: 20,918 sqm, 2,800 racks at 3kVA/rack, opened July 2009 in Huayuan Industrial Park; capacity_mw approximates rack apparent power; Vertiv case separately documents Tianjin Unicom Airport Building 3 (8,130 sqm, 8 IDC rooms).

name: Tianjin Wuqing China Telecom Data Center
developer: China Telecom Tianjin / IDC operator partners
notes: Commercial listing: 1,200 racks, 12,000 sqm, opened July 2010 in Wuqing Economic Development Zone; capacity_mw approximates 1,200 racks x 2.2kVA/rack. Exact IT MW not disclosed.

name: Ningsuan Tibet Cloud Computing Data Center / Ningsuan Data Center Phase I
developer: Tibet Ningsuan Technology Group
notes: Tibet government/Tibet Daily: Lhasa High-Tech Zone project is Tibet's largest/highest-altitude cloud-computing data center: 645,000 sqm site, 400,000 sqm green data center, RMB11.8bn over three phases, 70,000 cabinets at full buildout; phase I accepted 2020-12-18, stage 2 begun with 10,000 racks expected after phase I. MW not disclosed.

name: China Mobile Tibet Lhasa Data Center
developer: China Mobile Tibet
notes: County-government repost: China Mobile (Tibet Lhasa) Data Center phase-1 electromechanical works completed and put into operation; Lhasa High-Tech Zone key project with RMB739m investment, 63 mu, 51,405 sqm building area and 6,600 designed server cabinets. MW not disclosed.

name: National Tibetan Plateau Data Center Tibet Branch
developer: Tibet science-and-technology department / CAS Institute of Tibetan Plateau Research / Tibet Ningsuan Technology Group
notes: Tibet government: launched in Lhasa, jointly built by regional sci-tech department, CAS Institute of Tibetan Plateau Research and Tibet Ningsuan Technology Group; research/scientific data center; MW not disclosed.
